21a29f903d75e154.column_purpose: Primary key. Unique atom identifier, formed as <molecule_id>_<atom_index>, e.g. TR031_31 is atom 31 of molecule TR031. Referenced by the 'connected' table (both endpoint columns), which links atoms to each other.

2c5611edce271204.column_purpose: Foreign key to molecule.col_001. The molecule (TR###) this atom belongs to; the numeric suffix of col_001 matches this value.

620a2b85cf856e01.column_purpose: Chemical element symbol of the atom, lowercase (h, c, o, n, cl, br, p, si, zn, ...). 21 distinct elements across the dataset.

7451daa5e184f412.column_purpose: Primary key. Composite code: molecule ID (e.g. TR031) plus the two atom indices joined by the bond (e.g. _18_36), matching the pattern of the sample rows and the referenced_by join from connected.col_003.

47a1cf479383f5b5.column_purpose: Identifier of the molecule containing the bond; references molecule.col_001 (many bonds per molecule, 444 distinct molecules).

4bae9ad5e7518c91.column_purpose: Bond order in chemical notation: '-' single bond (10528), '=' double bond (1844), '#' triple bond (6).
